Class SubstrateCryptoAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.crypto.SubstrateCryptoAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @AutoConfigureBefore(SubstrateAutoConfiguration.class) @EnableConfigurationProperties(SubstrateCryptoProperties.class) public class SubstrateCryptoAutoConfiguration extends Object
Auto-configuration for AES-GCM payload encryption.

Activation matrix:

  • No shared-key, no user resolver, no user transformer → PayloadTransformer.IDENTITY from substrate-core
  • substrate.crypto.shared-key set, no user resolver → shared resolver + AES-GCM transformer
  • User SecretKeyResolver bean, no user transformer → AES-GCM transformer wrapping the user's resolver
  • User PayloadTransformer bean → user's transformer wins
